device_label: Differential-drive lumped-electrode EML (CMBH DFB + shallow-ridge EAM), wire-bonded CoC, 55 C
epitaxy_or_stack: Capped mesa buried heterostructure DFB waveguide integrated with shallow-ridge EA modulator on semi-insulating InP; MQW design not described
modulation_format: BTB PAM4 160 GBd (320 Gb/s), RF ER 3.8 dB; PAM6 160 GBd (413 Gb/s), RF ER 3.3 dB; 15-tap FFE, 1.5 Vppd, 55 C, 130 mA laser bias
driver: 2-channel AWG with 110 GHz amplifiers (bias tees), 1.5 Vppd; 90 ohm differential termination on AlN carrier, wire bonds; 110 GHz GSGSG probe for S-parameters
notes: Static (DC) ER over 30 dB at 55 C, 100 mA laser (Fig. 2). Facet power over 11.5 dBm at 0 V, 6.5 dBm under modulation. SDD11 below -5 dB to 110 GHz; simulated flip-chip curve not entered. SSD21 ripple: dips just below -3 dB near 72 GHz (about -3.3 dB, Fig. 5 reading); 83 GHz is the final crossing.

device_label: Differential-drive EML with tandem dual EAM (EA1 + EA2 in series), chip-on-carrier, 55 C
epitaxy_or_stack: DFB laser, two series EA modulators and passive waveguide joined by butt-joint regrowth on semi-insulating InP; p-InP cladding, mesa buried by semi-insulating InP; n+ InP cathode access layer
modulation_format: PAM4 113.4375 GBd (SSPRQ), 2.0 Vpp differential, 15-tap FFE: ER 5.2 dB, OMA 8.6 dBm, TDECQ 1.28 dB at SER 9.6e-3 (56.72 GHz Bessel-Thomson filter)
driver: Keysight M8199B AWG with SHF T850 C-04 amplifiers (bias tees); 110 GHz GSGSG probe; chip-on-carrier with 150 ohm differential termination
notes: EA1 (laser side) driven by positive phase, EA2 by negative phase; EA1 longer than EA2, lengths not given. Static ER 22 dB for 0 to -3 V. Operating bias -1.7 V. Return loss below -10 dB and CMRR above 15 dB to 60 GHz.

device_label: Differentially driven EML with dual series-connected high-mesa EAMs, CoC, 55 C
epitaxy_or_stack: Monolithic buried-heterostructure DFB laser, two series-connected high-mesa EAM waveguides (common GND electrode) and spot-size converter; laser and EAM cathodes electrically isolated
modulation_format: PAM4 differential, 15-tap FFE, SER 9.6e-3: BtB 180 GBd (360 Gb/s) TDECQ 3.3 dB, 170 GBd (340 Gb/s) 2.1 dB; 500 m 170 GBd 3.1 dB, 180 GBd 5.4 dB; 2 km up to 160 GBd (320 Gb/s) below 3.4 dB
driver: Keysight M8199B AWG with raised-cosine shaping and electrical amplifier, 1.5 Vppd, RF probe; 100 ohm (2 x 50 ohm) termination, junction-up wire-bonded CoC
notes: EAMs biased +2.3 V and -2.3 V on a common GND electrode; DFB 100 mA, threshold 8 mA, 19 mW output. S21 is the differential value computed from the two EAMs. Transmission over 500 m and 2 km.

device_label: 80 um EAM of a 4-channel uncooled EML array (350 um DFB, 80 um EAM, 150 um SOA), ridge, 50 C
epitaxy_or_stack: Single InGaAlAs MQW layer stack shared by DFB (lambda/4, index-coupled grating), EAM and SOA; ridge waveguide; tilted AR-coated front facet
modulation_format: BtB PAM4 145 GBd (290 Gb/s) BER below 3.8e-3 on all four channels at 10 dBm Rx power; 140 GBd over up to 11 km SSMF; 140 GBd uncooled 25 to 85 C; Vpp 1.2 V
driver: DAC with 80 GHz analog bandwidth at 256 GS/s, RF probe with integrated 50 ohm matching resistor; no driver IC
notes: Bandwidth density 770 Gb/s/mm at 375 um pitch. Ex-facet power over 24 mW (SOA 80 mA), about 10 dBm modulated. Crosstalk below -32.2 dB (noise limited), -40.9 dB above noise floor. EAM bias -2 V (CW), -1.9 V (PAM4, 50 C).
